import outputs.Algorithms.MuonBest
import LongTails.Proofs.MuonExecution
import LongTails.Proofs.MuonMatrix
import LongTails.Proofs.Execution

open MeasureTheory

namespace outputs.Proofs.MuonBest

open OracleTemplate OracleTemplate.Muon

open outputs.Algorithms.MuonBest

theorem execute_best (p : outputs.Algorithms.MuonBest.Public)
    (G : Mat p.m p.n → Mat p.m p.n) (O : Oracle (Mat p.m p.n) (Mat p.m p.n))
    (hO : ∀ k W seed, O.answer k (0, W) seed = G W)
    (K : ℕ) (seed : (algorithm p).Seed) (tape : (k : ℕ) → O.Seed k) :
    execute O (algorithm p) (fun _ => K) seed tape = (stateAt p G K).best := by sorry

theorem best_gradient (p : outputs.Algorithms.MuonBest.Public)
    (G : Mat p.m p.n → Mat p.m p.n) (K : ℕ) (hK : 1 ≤ K) :
    (stateAt p G K).point = OracleTemplate.SimplifiedMuon.trajectory (sourceInput p) G K ∧
    nuclearNorm (G (stateAt p G K).best) ≤ (1 / (K : ℝ)) *
      ∑ j : Fin K, nuclearNorm (G (OracleTemplate.SimplifiedMuon.trajectory (sourceInput p) G j.val)) := by sorry

end outputs.Proofs.MuonBest
